notes.title: Big Update to v2.0!
notes.notes:
Version 2.0 update includes...
- New Achievements
- New Power-ups in the form of 3 visors which unlock abilities: shields, past echos and the ability to see reach the true ending of the game!
- New Secret Rooms
- Bug Fixes
- New Music
- New Backgrounds
- New Controls Screen
- Many more small bits here and there!
Enjoy!
James

notes.title: Small update to add windowed mode and vibration toggle
notes.notes: Resizeable windowed mode and controller vibration toggle are now avaliable through the options menu of the game. Thanks to Lugum and Sasha Zenko for the suggestions!

notes.title: Small update to remove deaths from fall damage.
notes.notes:
Death from fall damage has been removed from the game. In testing it seemed too unpredictable to reliably judge, making an already hard game even harder.
It may return at some point as a setting the player can choose to turn on or off.
This does remove some of the puzzle element of the game. Each level now has several more paths to choose from for completion. Overall it has made the game a little easier, but more enjoyable to play. Thanks to everyone Beta testing!
